latest_release.name: NVIDIA Megatron-Bridge 0.7.0
latest_release.body:
## **Highlights**

### **Model Collection Support**

#### **LLM**

* **DeepSeek V4** — enhanced support with MCore `HybridModel` on main branch; library configs modernized; multi-node inference launcher ([PR\#5860](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5860?ref=relnotes), [PR\#5554](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5554?ref=relnotes), [PR\#6163](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6163?ref=relnotes))  
* **GLM-5.2** — enhanced support with MCore `HybridModel`, with shared GLM-5.2/5.3 bridge compatibility ([PR\#6158](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6158?ref=relnotes), [PR\#6117](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6117?ref=relnotes))  
* **Kimi K3** — language backbone ([PR\#5130](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5130?ref=relnotes))  
* **Muse Glimmer 30B** ([PR\#5479](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5479?ref=relnotes), [PR\#6255](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6255?ref=relnotes))  
* **K-EXAONE 2.0** ([PR\#5191](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5191?ref=relnotes), community @eagle705)  
* **Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B** and **Beam 1.0 501B-A23B** are on `main`, not in 0.7.0. Verified with Megatron Bridge `main` in the NeMo 26.10 container plus Transformers 5.20.1; see their verification cards.

#### **VLM / Multimodal**

* **Nemotron 3.5 Super VL** — support, text-only conversion, MoE fine-tuning state and verification refresh ([PR\#6100](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6100?ref=relnotes), [PR\#6130](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6130?ref=relnotes), [PR\#6220](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6220?ref=relnotes))  
* **BAGEL-7B-MoT** — T2I / editing / VLM WebDataset conversion, BAGEL MIMO construction, flow-matching schedule, H100 pretrain and finetune recipes ([PR\#5605](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5605?ref=relnotes), community @ympcMark)

#### **Diffusion**

* **DiffusionGemma** — bridge ([PR\#6284](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6284?ref=relnotes), community @BenDGeist)

### **Training & Functionality**

* **Multi-LoRA and MoE PEFT**  
  * Multi-LoRA for Megatron models ([PR\#4218](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/4218?ref=relnotes), community @mathewjhan), with seeded slot re-initialization ([PR\#6068](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6068?ref=relnotes), community @yushengsu-thu)  
  * LoRA on grouped MoE expert linears ([PR\#5155](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5155?ref=relnotes), community @yushengsu-thu), fused expert LoRA output merge ([PR\#6041](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6041?ref=relnotes), community @j316chuck)  
  * LoRALinear wrap of the `nn.Linear` LoRA path ([PR\#5310](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5310?ref=relnotes), community @HollowMan6), merge-before-quantize ([PR\#5384](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5384?ref=relnotes), community @HollowMan6), `expand_shared_outer` export ([PR\#5588](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5588?ref=relnotes), community @HollowMan6), LoRA+ LR split ([PR\#5589](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5589?ref=relnotes), community @HollowMan6), 3D-MoE LoRA export ([PR\#5939](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5939?ref=relnotes), community @HollowMan6)  
  * LoRA branch input no longer pre-quantized ([PR\#6342](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6342?ref=relnotes))  
* **SFT data: in-batch packing and multi-source blending** — GPT SFT in-batch packing ([PR\#5493](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5493?ref=relnotes)), native Energon packing for Qwen3-VL ([PR\#5285](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/5285?ref=relnotes)), direct-HF and JSONL blending ([PR\#5438](https://gith
